note: A rectified street-panorama crop of one Amsterdam house front plus eight colour swatches. The photo may have shadow, glare or a colour cast from the camera.

wall_colour.instructions: Which swatch is closest to the true colour of the main wall of the house front in `facade` above the ground floor (the colour the wall would have in neutral daylight)? Ignore shadows, bright glare and any colour cast from the camera; judge the paint or brick itself, and ignore white window frames, trim and the sky.

near_black_painted.description: Near-black, charcoal or very dark grey painted wall.

pale_salmon_brick.description: Pale salmon, pinkish or light brown-grey brick.

white_plaster.description: White or cream plaster or painted white wall.

grey_stone.description: Mid grey stone, concrete or grey brick.
